shots.action: Night storm over a rocky headland. A stone lighthouse stands against a black sky, waves breaking white at its base, rain streaking sideways through the air. Sheet lightning flares far out over the water, briefly silhouetting the tower, and its lantern room stays dark.
subjects: the storm-lashed lighthouse on its rocky headland
the black sea and breaking waves
the dark lantern room at the top of the tower
sync_sound: distant thunder rolling over the sea
shots.what_changes: The lightning flare reveals the tower and recedes, leaving the lantern room unlit.

shots.action: Inside the tower, a weathered lighthouse keeper in a heavy oilskin coat climbs a curving iron staircase, one hand on the cold rail, the other carrying a lit hand lantern that throws swinging light across damp stone walls. He leans into each step as the wind moans against the tower.
subjects: the lighthouse keeper in an oilskin coat
the curving iron staircase and damp stone walls
sync_sound: the creak of the lantern handle
shots.what_changes: The keeper advances upward around the curve of the stairs, the lantern light sweeping with him.

shots.action: The keeper pauses on the last flight, chest heaving, rain and salt water running off his beard. He grips the rail, looks up toward the hatch of the lantern room, and pushes himself on, jaw set.
subjects: the lighthouse keeper's face, wet with rain and salt
his gloved hand on the iron rail
shots.what_changes: His exhaustion turns to resolve and he starts moving again.

shots.action: In the glass lantern room the keeper sets his hand lantern down, turns the brass valve, and the great lamp ignites with a bloom of white light. He steps back as the rotating lens sends a broad beam out through the rain, sweeping across the black water.
subjects: the keeper standing beside the great lamp
the brass lamp mechanism and rotating lens
the beam cutting into the rain over the sea
sync_sound: the lamp catching with a low roar
wind and rain against the glass
shots.what_changes: The lamp lights for the first time and the beam sweeps out into the storm.
